in_sanskrit.name: अलोकेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows light, illumination or wisdom. A name derived from the Sanskrit root 'alok' meaning 'to see, perceive, or illuminate'.

in_hindi.name: अलोकेश
in_hindi.meaning: अलोक (alok) - light, radiance, vision; ईश (ish) - lord, ruler, god.
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who bestows light or illumination. A name derived from the Sanskrit roots 'alok' and 'ish'.

in_tamil.name: அலோகேஷ
in_tamil.meaning: அலோக (alok) - light, radiance, vision; இஷ் (ish) - lord, ruler, god.
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who bestows light or illumination. A name derived from the Tamil roots 'alok' and 'ish'.

in_telugu.name: అలోకేశ
in_telugu.meaning: అలోక (alok) - light, radiance, vision; ఇశ్ (ish) - lord, ruler, god.

in_marathi.name: Alokesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant or Shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alokesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root "alok" meaning 'to see' or 'to shine'. The name Alokesh denotes one who illuminates or shines like the sun.
